Ticket keys are fixture keys (CUP_…, mapped with demo/jira-keys.json) or live keys. A question passes when 'found' matches and, for found questions, at least 'min' of 'expect' (tickets; a cited commit counts for the keys in its subject) are cited, every path in 'files' is cited, and the answer names one of 'names'. Kinds: history, why, where, who, latest, cross-app, language (not English), url, not-found.
